package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const (
	diagnosticHTTPStudent = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	diagnosticHTTPAttempt = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	diagnosticHTTPTask    = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	diagnosticHTTPLesson  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
)

type diagnosticHTTPRepo struct {
	attempt                        domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt
	getErr, submitErr, completeErr error
	submit                         repository.DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand
	submitCalls, completeCalls     int
	result                         domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult
}

func (f *diagnosticHTTPRepo) ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentReserveCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return f.attempt, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPRepo) ReplayDiagnosticReservation(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPRepo) ReplayDiagnosticSubmission(context.Context, string, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPRepo) GetDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	return f.attempt, f.getErr
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPRepo) GetCurrentDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	return f.attempt, f.getErr
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPRepo) SubmitDiagnosticAssessment(_ context.Context, c repository.DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	f.submitCalls++
	f.submit = c
	return f.attempt, false, f.submitErr
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPRepo) CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(_ context.Context, _ repository.DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, bool, error) {
	f.completeCalls++
	return f.result, false, f.completeErr
}

type diagnosticHTTPTasks struct {
	task  *answer.TaskMetadata
	calls int
}

func (f *diagnosticHTTPTasks) GetTask(context.Context, string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	f.calls++
	return f.task, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPTasks) GetDiagnosticTask(context.Context, string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	f.calls++
	return f.task, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticHTTPTasks) GetCourseStructure(context.Context, string) (*answer.CourseStructure, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("not used")
}

func diagnosticHTTPAttemptFixture() domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-attempt.v1", ID: diagnosticHTTPAttempt, PlanID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", PlanRevision: 1, PlanDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), Items: []domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{{LessonID: diagnosticHTTPLesson, TaskID: diagnosticHTTPTask, TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: 0, TaskOrder: 0, LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}}}, SubmittedItems: 1}
}

func diagnosticHTTPTaskFixture() *answer.TaskMetadata {
	return &answer.TaskMetadata{
		ID: diagnosticHTTPTask, LessonID: diagnosticHTTPLesson, Version: 1,
		UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Type: 11,
		AssessmentPurpose:  "diagnostic",
		EvaluationMode:     "AUTO",
		LearningTargets:    []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}},
		AllowedErrorsCount: 0,
		Tests: []answer.TaskTestMetadata{{
			ID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", Kind: "single_choice",
			Variants: []answer.TaskTestVariantMetadata{{ID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", IsCorrect: true}, {ID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"}},
		}},
	}
}

func diagnosticHTTPRouter(handler DiagnosticAssessmentHandler) chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware{}.Middleware)
	r.Use(middleware.RequireRole("STUDENT", "STUDENT_PRO"))
	r.Get("/student/diagnostic-assessments/current", handler.GetCurrent)
	r.Get("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}", handler.Get)
	r.Get("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/tasks/{taskID}", handler.GetTask)
	r.Post("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/tasks/{taskID}/submit", handler.Submit)
	r.Post("/student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/complete", handler.Complete)
	return r
}

func TestDiagnosticHTTPTaskRenderAndCurrentAreOwnerScopedAndPrivate(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &diagnosticHTTPRepo{attempt: diagnosticHTTPAttemptFixture()}
	router := diagnosticHTTPRouter(DiagnosticAssessmentHandler{Assessments: studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Tasks: &diagnosticHTTPTasks{task: diagnosticHTTPTaskFixture()}}})
	for _, path := range []string{
		"/student/diagnostic-assessments/current",
		"/student/diagnostic-assessments/" + diagnosticHTTPAttempt + "/tasks/" + diagnosticHTTPTask,
	} {
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodGet, path, "", diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT"))
		if response.Code != http.StatusOK || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
			t.Fatalf("path=%s status=%d headers=%v", path, response.Code, response.Header())
		}
		body := response.Body.String()
		for _, forbidden := range []string{"is_correct", "correct_order", "group_id", "group_source_key", "expected_answers", "compose", "starter", "runtime"} {
			if strings.Contains(body, forbidden) {
				t.Fatalf("path=%s leaked %q: %s", path, forbidden, body)
			}
		}
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodGet, "/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+diagnosticHTTPAttempt+"/tasks/aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "", diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT"))
	if response.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("unfrozen status=%d", response.Code)
	}
}

func diagnosticHTTPRequest(method, path, body, student, role string) *http.Request {
	r := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	r.Header.Set("X-User-ID", student)
	r.Header.Set("X-User-Role", role)
	r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999")
	return r
}

func TestDiagnosticHTTPProjectionRedactsAnswersAndFrozenMetadataIsSafe(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &diagnosticHTTPRepo{attempt: diagnosticHTTPAttemptFixture()}
	router := diagnosticHTTPRouter(DiagnosticAssessmentHandler{Assessments: studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo}})
	req := diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodGet, "/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+diagnosticHTTPAttempt, "", diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, req)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d headers=%v", response.Code, response.Header())
	}
	body := response.Body.String()
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"is_correct", "correct_variant", "answer_key", "scorer", "mastery", "path", "raw_response"} {
		if strings.Contains(body, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("projection leaked %q: %s", forbidden, body)
		}
	}
	var projection diagnosticAttemptProjection
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &projection); err != nil || projection.TotalItems != 1 || projection.Items[0].TaskID != diagnosticHTTPTask {
		t.Fatalf("bad safe projection: %+v %v", projection, err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticHTTPSubmitScoresFrozenTaskAndCompleteProjectsSafeResult(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &diagnosticHTTPRepo{attempt: diagnosticHTTPAttemptFixture(), result: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1", StudentID: diagnosticHTTPStudent, CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", AttemptID: diagnosticHTTPAttempt, PlanID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", PlanRevision: 1, Correct: 1, Total: 1, Percent: 100, Band: "ADVANCED"}}
	// Submit uses the pure scorer; this fixture intentionally has one item only,
	// so exercise the projection boundary with a repository-produced result.
	reqBody := `{"answers":[{"test_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","variant_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"}]}`
	router := diagnosticHTTPRouter(DiagnosticAssessmentHandler{Assessments: studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Tasks: &diagnosticHTTPTasks{task: diagnosticHTTPTaskFixture()}}})
	req := diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+diagnosticHTTPAttempt+"/tasks/"+diagnosticHTTPTask+"/submit", reqBody, diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT_PRO")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, req)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" || repo.submitCalls != 1 || !repo.submit.Correct {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d command=%+v", response.Code, repo.submitCalls, repo.submit)
	}
	if strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "correct_variant") || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "raw_response") {
		t.Fatalf("submit leaked scorer data: %s", response.Body.String())
	}
	completeBody := diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+diagnosticHTTPAttempt+"/complete", `{}`, diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT")
	complete := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(complete, completeBody)
	if complete.Code != http.StatusOK || complete.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" || repo.completeCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("complete status=%d calls=%d", complete.Code, repo.completeCalls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticHTTPAuthAndMalformedInputsNeverReachUsecase(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &diagnosticHTTPRepo{attempt: diagnosticHTTPAttemptFixture()}
	router := diagnosticHTTPRouter(DiagnosticAssessmentHandler{Assessments: studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Tasks: &diagnosticHTTPTasks{task: diagnosticHTTPTaskFixture()}}})
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, student, role string
		want                int
	}{
		{"missing", "", "", http.StatusUnauthorized}, {"wrong role", diagnosticHTTPStudent, "TEACHER", http.StatusForbidden},
	} {
		req := diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodGet, "/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+diagnosticHTTPAttempt, "", tc.student, tc.role)
		if tc.student == "" {
			req.Header.Del("X-User-ID")
		}
		if tc.role == "" {
			req.Header.Del("X-User-Role")
		}
		got := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(got, req)
		if got.Code != tc.want || repo.getErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("%s status=%d want=%d", tc.name, got.Code, tc.want)
		}
	}
	for _, body := range []string{"{} trailing", `{"answers":[]}`, strings.Repeat("x", int(diagnosticAssessmentBodyLimit+1))} {
		req := diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+diagnosticHTTPAttempt+"/tasks/"+diagnosticHTTPTask+"/submit", body, diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT")
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999")
		got := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(got, req)
		if got.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || got.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" || repo.submitCalls != 0 {
			t.Errorf("body=%q status=%d calls=%d", body[:min(len(body), 20)], got.Code, repo.submitCalls)
		}
	}
	for _, key := range []string{" 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", "99999999-9999-4999-8999-99999999999A"} {
		req := diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+diagnosticHTTPAttempt+"/tasks/"+diagnosticHTTPTask+"/submit", `{"answers":[{"test_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","variant_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"}]}`, diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT")
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
		got := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(got, req)
		if got.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || got.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" || repo.submitCalls != 0 {
			t.Errorf("key=%q status=%d calls=%d", key, got.Code, repo.submitCalls)
		}
	}
	for _, path := range []string{"/student/diagnostic-assessments/not-a-uuid", "/student/diagnostic-assessments/" + diagnosticHTTPAttempt + "/tasks/not-a-uuid/submit"} {
		req := diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodGet, path, "", diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT")
		if strings.HasSuffix(path, "/submit") {
			req.Method = http.MethodPost
			req.Body = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(`{}`))
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		}
		got := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(got, req)
		if got.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || got.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
			t.Errorf("path=%q status=%d", path, got.Code)
		}
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticHTTPRequestHashBindsAuthenticatedStudent(t *testing.T) {
	body := []byte(`{"answers":[]}`)
	a, _, okA := diagnosticRequestKey(diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/p", string(body), diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT"), diagnosticHTTPStudent, body)
	b, _, okB := diagnosticRequestKey(diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/p", string(body), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "STUDENT"), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", body)
	if !okA || !okB || a != b {
		t.Fatalf("key parsing changed unexpectedly")
	}
	_, hashA, _ := diagnosticRequestKey(diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/p", string(body), diagnosticHTTPStudent, "STUDENT"), diagnosticHTTPStudent, body)
	_, hashB, _ := diagnosticRequestKey(diagnosticHTTPRequest(http.MethodPost, "/p", string(body), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "STUDENT"), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", body)
	if hashA == hashB {
		t.Fatal("request hash did not bind student")
	}
}

func min(a, b int) int {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}
